title: Part History search shows only the bin rows that match
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a part, part A, whose Part History has one entry split into a bin location A row and a bin location B row.
  • Start on part A's Part History page (the clock icon at the left of its row).
custom_steps:
1. Type bin location A's name in the Part History search.
  2. Replace the text with the Staff name shown on that entry.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry shows only its bin location A row; the bin location B row is hidden.

Step 2:

  • Part A's entry shows both bin rows: a Staff name match shows every bin row.
